lagNote: Chromium 152 ESR with security fixes from Chromium 156 (Vivaldi 8.2.4133.96)
summary: Chromium Extended Stable base with out-of-schedule security backports, Google Safe Browsing, Chrome Web Store extensions, and a Hall of Fame instead of a cash bounty.

incidents.title: CVE-2026-5281 (Dawn use-after-free) fixed in Vivaldi 7.9
incidents.detail: Vivaldi's release post says the Dawn WebGPU bug has a known exploit in the wild; fixed with Chromium 146.0.7680.182.

incidents.title: CVE-2026-11645 (V8 out-of-bounds access) fixed in Vivaldi 8.0
incidents.detail: Vivaldi's release post says the V8 bug has a known exploit in the wild; fixed in Chromium 148.0.7778.263 ESR.

incidents.title: CVE-2026-85046 (V8 type confusion) fixed in Vivaldi 8.2
incidents.detail: Vivaldi changelog lists the V8 type confusion fix in Chromium 152.0.7977.112 (build 4133.45), alongside Vivaldi-specific calendar fixes.
